appearance.subtle: There is a faint clicking when they enter a room.
appearance.obvious: They click steadily as they move, head tilting, and they navigate a dark room without slowing down.
appearance.extreme: The clicking is constant and loud enough to feel. Their eyes have gone milky and useless and it has not slowed them at all.

description: You have started making a sound too high to hear and reading the room off what comes back. Darkness and smoke stopped mattering.
drawbacks: The clicking is constant and people notice
name: Echolocation
